The Reason Doctors Fear Surviving A Heart Attack More Than Dying From One

Top Cardiologist 2025 Dr. Peter Harrington, M.D.

Dr. Peter Harrington, MD, spent thirty years in vascular medicine, the last nine as Chief of Hypertension and Vascular Medicine at Johns Hopkins. He has helped write the textbooks his field trains on, and has been brought in as an expert on national health panels across the country. His work focuses on what sustained pressure does to the smallest vessels in the body, and on the disability that follows a cardiovascular event.
